MTech-EE.note: the EE site describes the thesis structure (42 coursework + 40 thesis); the coursework track uses the Adv5 common track rules plus the EE discipline rules (D3)

MTech-ICDT.note: separate degree on the EE site; no streams, its course list is its discipline basket

precedence: a rule with 'overrides' replaces the named common rule for its programmes

placeholder_codes.REQ-HSS: HSS course, no single timetable code (HS xxx courses qualify)
placeholder_codes.REQ-THESIS: M.Tech thesis unit, no code in the Sem-I 2026-27 timetable
placeholder_codes.REQ-PROJECT: PG project course, no code in the Sem-I 2026-27 timetable

total_min_credits.quote: the total minimum credit requirement for both MTech (Coursework Track) or MTech (Thesis Track) is 82

coursework_min_credits.thesis.quote: Students in the MTech (Thesis Track) will be required to earn at least 32 credits through coursework, at least 32 credits through thesis units

thesis_min_credits.thesis.quote: at least 32 credits through thesis units and 2 credits of postgraduate orientation programme Aarohan

coursework_min_credits.coursework.quote: Students in the MTech (Coursework Track) will be required to earn at least 48 credits through coursework

project_min_credits.coursework.quote: at least 16 credits through project courses and 2 credits of postgraduate orientation programme Aarohan

aarohan_credits.quote: Completing PG Orientation Programme Aarohan (2 Credits) is a mandatory graduation requirement for all MTech students

aarohan_fail_extra_hss_credits.note: students joining from Semester II 2022-23 onwards
aarohan_fail_extra_hss_credits.quote: In cases where a student fails to clear Aarohan, they must clear an additional two credits worth of HSS courses for graduation

writing_credits.quote: The 4-credit “Writing” course will be required for all students.

hss_min_credits.quote: For students admitted before AY 2025-26, in addition to the Writing course, at least 4 credits will have to be earned through Humanities and Social Sciences (HSS) courses

hss_ug_courses_allowed.quote: One undergraduate level HSS course may be counted towards this requirement.

applications_of_ai_credits.note: for MTech AI and MTech CSE this is Ethics of AI
applications_of_ai_credits.quote: For students admitted from AY 2025-26, 4 credits of Applications of AI courses relevant to the discipline is mandatory

applications_of_ai_course.quote: the 4 credits of course on Applications of AI relevant to the discipline shall be “Ethics of AI”

electives_min_credits.quote: Students must take at least 8 credits of electives inside or outside the discipline.

discipline_specified_min_credits.note: the CSE structure lists the discipline courses: compulsory, stream core and baskets. It does not say whether CS 610/CS 621 count inside these 16 credits
discipline_specified_min_credits.quote: Students must take at least 16 credits of courses specified by the discipline.

ug_courses_max.note: besides one UG level HSS course. Sources cap the number of UG courses, not a credit total
ug_courses_max.quote: Two undergraduate level courses (with course codes 1XX to 5XX) may be counted towards graduation requirements (besides one UG level HSS course).

below_600_constraint_applies.quote: For any < 600 level course, the usual constraint on the number of such credits permissible applies.

physical_education_courses.when: one each in the first two semesters
physical_education_courses.quote: must complete two Physical Education (PE) courses, one each in their first two semesters, as part of their graduation requirements

pe_credits_each.quote: 2 physical education courses of zero credit each.

compulsory_courses.quote: CS 610 (Algorithms) is a compulsory course for all streams

compulsory_cs621.quote: CS 621 (Ethics of AI) is a compulsory course for all streams (Offered in Even semester).

stream_core_credits.quote: the core courses (in red below - 8 credits)

own_basket_min_credits.quote: at least 4 credits in the respective baskets (in blue below)

other_basket_min_credits.note: from any of the other two baskets
other_basket_min_credits.quote: at least 4 credits from any of the other two baskets

mtech_ai_stream.quote: MTech in AI is deemed to be in the AI-ML stream only and should follow the corresponding curriculum.

online_courses_count.quote: Note that no online courses count here.

thesis_unit_credits.note: register for one unit or a multiple of it
thesis_unit_credits.quote: A student may register for one 4 credit thesis unit or a multiple of it

thesis_first_semester.note: normally no thesis registration in the first semester, thesis in the remaining three
thesis_first_semester.quote: It is normally expected that students will not register for the thesis in their first semester

thesis_summer_credits.note: about 10 credits of thesis in summer unless waived
thesis_summer_credits.quote: register for about 10 credits of thesis in summer unless there is a specific waiver on justifiable grounds

thesis_project_grades.quote: The thesis units will be graded using A, B, C and F grades, where A, B and C are passing grades and F is a fail grade.

thesis_f_credits_exit.note: exit if F grades in more than 20 thesis credits
thesis_f_credits_exit.quote: If a student accumulates F grades in more than 20 credits of thesis units any time during their MTech programme, the student will have to exit the programme.

thesis_grades_in_cpi.quote: Thesis grades will not be counted towards CPI calculation.

project_grades.quote: The project courses will be graded using only A, B, C and F grades

project_credits_in_cpi.quote: the credits earned through project courses will be counted towards CPI calculation.

credit_expiry_years.quote: credits earned older than eight years will be deemed expired

extension_request_after_semesters.quote: After 7 semesters, a request from the student is needed to extend the programme

fellowship_min_cpi.quote: In case the CPI of a student falls below 6.0 out of 10, the fellowship provided, if any, by the Institute will be stopped

min_cpi_graduation.quote: The minimum CPI for graduation is 6.0 out of 10.

min_cpi_continuation.quote: The minimum CPI for continuing in the programme at any point is 5.5 out of 10.

max_duration_years.quote: Full-time MTech students will have a maximum of three years to obtain the degree.

track_change_deadline.quote: Students may request a change of track once during their programme of study, but at the latest, by the beginning of the second semester.

pass_fail_conversions_max.note: converted course is dropped from CPI
pass_fail_conversions_max.quote: Each student will have this option available for a maximum of two courses for conversion during the entire programme.

pass_fail_earliest.quote: The students in other programmes can use this option any time after their first semester into the programme.

repeat_best_grade_counts.quote: Better of the two grades will be counted towards CPI calculation

elective_substitution.quote: A student can substitute one elective course by another elective course to improve his/her CPI

standard_course_credits.quote: Usually the courses will have 3 lectures per week with approximately 40 lecture hours in a semester, which is defined as a 4 credit course.

course_credit_range.quote: a course may usually have credits in the range of 1-5

early_admit_same_curriculum.quote: The fees structure, the curriculum as well as other regulations will be same as that of the regular MTech programme at IIT Gandhinagar.

early_admit_extra_fellowship_cpi.quote: The continuation of additional fellowship beyond the first semester is subject to the student maintaining a CPI 8.0 and above.

ee.credit_split.quote: 42 credits through coursework and 40 credits through thesis credits.

ee.applications_of_ai_credits.note: the EE site does not name the course
ee.applications_of_ai_credits.quote: 4 credits of Applications of AI courses relevant to the discipline

ee.discipline_specified_min_credits.quote: Courses specified by the Discipline - At least 16 Credits

ee.fellowship_after_aarohan.quote: Fellowship (if eligible) will be usually released only after completion of Aarohan.

ee.ug_elective_credits_max.quote: A maximum of 8 Credits from the Electives group can be at the undergraduate level (Course Code 5XX or below).

ee.other_courses_min_level.quote: All other courses MUST be at the postgraduate level (Course Code 6XX or above).

ee.mooc_electives_allowed.note: pre-approved MOOCs only, electives group only, within approved credit limits
ee.mooc_electives_allowed.quote: Pre-approved MOOCs, subject to approved credit limits, can be considered for courses from the Electives group.

ee.sub_specialisations.degree: MTech (Electrical Engineering), no specialization on the degree
ee.sub_specialisations.quote: The following sub-specializations are offered for MTech in Electrical Engineering, for students admitted from 2025-26.

ee.icdt_degree.note: modelled as the separate programme MTech-ICDT without streams (docs/DECISIONS.md D2)
ee.icdt_degree.quote: The degree offered is MTech (Integrated Circuit Design & Technology)

ee.discipline_list.Power Engineering & C.quote: Students must credit at least 16 credits of courses from this list under the 'Courses Specified by the Discipline' basket. The courses in this list can also be considered as Electives.

ee.discipline_list.Signal Processing & M.quote: Students must credit at least 16 credits of courses from this list under the 'Courses Specified by the Discipline' basket. The courses in this list can also be considered as Electives.

ee.discipline_list.MTech-ICDT.note: the page marks this list '*To be updated soon'; ICDT has no streams (docs/DECISIONS.md D2)
ee.discipline_list.MTech-ICDT.quote: Students must credit at least 16 credits of courses from this list under the 'Courses Specified by the Discipline' basket. The courses in this list can also be considered as Electives.

max_credits_per_semester.note: no maximum credits per semester is stated in Adv5, Adv17, Adv24, Adv42, the CSE structure or the EE M.Tech site
